source.note: Generated from v1 by a script kept outside the repo; see README.md in this folder.

mappings: v1 parse result `{ ok: true, model }` -> `{ kind: "ok" }`; `{ ok: false, kind, message }` -> `{ kind, message }`.
State field `composite` -> `isComposite` (op args use the port names).
Op args are written in the port's signatures; the generator maps them to v1's positional arguments (addTransition(m, from, to, label), addNote(m, target, side, text)).
Ops returning `{ model, id }` are compared on the model; `expected` is the serialized code after the step.
Layout positions are top-left corners rounded to 2 decimals; `l` is the label tag. Place cases start from v1's dagre layout of the previous code (rounded), stored in `start`.
